title: remind
description: Reminders sent between users. New ids are assigned in src/commands/remind/remind.js as (count(remind) + 1), so _id is a plain integer rather than an ObjectId.

senderId.description: Twitch user id of the sender

receiverId.description: Twitch user id of the recipient

fromChannelId.description: Channel where the reminder was created (null for legacy/whisper-created)

remindTime.description: Unix seconds when the reminder was created

remindAt.description: Unix seconds the reminder is scheduled to fire (null = next-time-they-talk)

beenRead.description: Flipped to true once delivered to the recipient
